takeaways.text: Lines up **Slot** on **67%** of 64 plays (n=43); also Wide (outside) 31% (n=20).
Runs a route on **100%** of dropbacks — about the WR average (100%). Effectively always a receiver; blocking is negligible.
On routes, averages **10.0 yd** downfield by the throw vs 11.2 for WRs (shallower) (n=64, snap→release window only).
Primary alignment is Slot (67%); a coach might set the first coverage answer to that spot. This is a hypothesis from observed tendencies, not a proven assignment.
